messages:
maria-finance: Heads-up — new price sheet v3 uploaded. Found 9 legacy reserved accounts that might fall through grandfathering when we flip the A/B PAYG change tomorrow. :eyes:
ash-product: Wait, I thought grandfathering covers existing reserved SKUs. What's leaking?
liam-billing: Our SKUs use aliases. The experiment relies on canonical SKU matching. Three old aliases aren't mapped, so those reserved customers would be treated as new and charged experiment rates.
sofia-legal: If they get misbilled we need a remediation path and pre-approved customer language. No customer outreach until legal signs off.
maria-finance: Cost exposure ~ $14k/month if all 9 are misbilled. Prefer patching the SKU alias table before rollout.
olivia-eng: I can patch the canonicalization table (single-row add). Low risk but needs a deploy. Can do a staging canary now.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: release/sku-alias-fix -> staging (build 4821). ETA 00:03:00.
nash-product: Hold the A/B rollout until you confirm prod is green.
liam-billing: Also flag — vendor passthrough surcharge increased for burst capacity; if the experiment causes token bursts margin gets hit.
maria-finance: Liam, estimate vendor fee delta if A cohort +20% usage?
liam-billing: ~ $1.8k/month additional across affected accounts. Adding to risk doc.
sofia-legal: Drafting a short notification template that offers a credit and points to billing portal. Will avoid language that admits fault.
olivia-eng: Staging canary passed. Running smoke reconciliation locally. Snippet:
````
# smoke check pseudocode
for acct in candidates:
  expected = legacy_price if acct.grandfathered else experiment_price
  if invoice_line != expected:
    mark_for_credit(acct)
````
liam-billing: Ran smoke on yesterday's export — found 2 accounts misclassified. Flagged.
maria-finance: If we credit those fully it's ~$2.35k. Sofia, legal okay with sending a credit + note?
sofia-legal: Yes, use the template. No blaming language.
maria-finance: Plan: 1) Olivia promotes SKU alias fix to prod and add a one-line migration note; 2) Billing runs reconciliation against latest invoices; 3) If any slipped, issue manual credits (pre-approved up to $25k).
nash-product: I will keep the feature flag off until reconciliation confirms zero mischarges. Ping me when clear.
deploy-bot: promoted release/sku-alias-fix -> prod (build 4821).
liam-billing: Credits queued for the 2 accounts. Command used internally:
````
billing credits create --account $ACCT_ID --amount $AMT --reason "grandfathering adjustment"
````
maria-finance: CFO approved remediation up to $25k (DM received). Document root cause and add a postmortem to the rollout ticket.
nash-product: Once reconciliation finishes and shows no remaining misclassifications I will flip the A/B split. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
